d: A 45-year-old woman dead after an argument  an immigrant dies suddenly.
A man believes that his brother was murdered by his ex-wife  a woman collapses on her way to bed.
The police discover the body of a man one morning in a restaurant, and it's now up to Dr. G to examine the body and solve the case.
A dead man is found hanging over the handrails of a footbridge  an all-night celebration is followed by death.

While some of the survivalists enjoy a bonanza of food, others are driven to increasingly desperate measures to sustain themselves  one hunter braves dangerous heights to stalk his prey, while another turns to a revolting food source.

A woman dies in her sleep after her character has changed drastically for no reason, but there does not seem to be any evidence of the cause of death  a drunk man wants to cycle to his friend at night and ends up dead on the roadside.
A retired soldier confesses to another soldier's murder  an elderly woman dies after a hip replacement surgery.
